Trevor's Old Man's Beard  has very large and very fragrant flower clusters that hang like pendants from the stem and limbs.
They are now called ‘travellers' joy’ or ‘old man's beard’, but their original name is worth recalling to indicate the reason for their popularity with tourists of old.
C. Vitalba is the most widely grown clematis in Australia. Other similar species are sometimes called Old Man's Beards and Golden Shears.
Old man's beard, Clematis aristata.
Clematis are mostly woody climbers and creepers with twining, often armed, stems. A favourite is Old Man's Beard, C. Vitalba.
Clematis aristata, also called Old Man's Beard or Wombat Hair, has long been recognized as a garden plant because it has such interesting berries.
Old man's beard (Usnea monoraphis) is a striking lichen that grows from the ground in dark brown tufts and has delicate grey hairs hanging from its surface.
It's also known as Old Man's Beard and when the hairs hang straight it is more commonly known as Dog Licking Plant.
